facts.fact: Smart Africa's director general says it has launched a cross-border digital identity pilot between Rwanda, Ghana and Benin; the interview gives no date for the launch, so its published date 2026-08-11 is used.

Smart Africa's director general says the cross-border digital identity pilot between Rwanda, Ghana and Benin has already been launched, with eighteen more countries in the process of joining; undated, so the published date 2026-08-11 is used.
